text:
emily: Heads up — opened PR to add a short migration appendix for Private installs migrating from v1 to v2 networking (includes kube-proxy notes, NAT64/IPv6 caveats, and HSM cert rollover steps). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2410. Looking for a quick doc + infra sanity pass before we merge.

frank: Nice. Can you call out the v1->v2 config key names? Customers keep tripping over the old `externalAddr` vs `public_host` rename.

emily: Good catch, added a table mapping old->new keys and a sample sed command to migrate: `sed -E 's/externalAddr/public_host/g' config.yml > config.v2.yml`. Kept it short so it fits the quickstart appendix.

greg: Two things from infra: 1) add a note about SNAT windows: sealed sites with Windows gateways often need masquerade enabled on the kube-proxy side; 2) HSM cert rotation — mention that some appliances require re-importing the token label after chain rotation.

frank: Also add an SDK snippet for the minimal retry logic for private endpoints (customers forget to set `insecure=false` in older SDKs). Something like:

```python
# minimal retry wrapper for private endpoint
import requests
from time import sleep

for attempt in range(3):
    r = requests.post('https://10.0.5.2:8443/api/generate', json=payload, verify='/etc/ssl/redwood-ca.pem')
    if r.ok:
        break
    sleep(2 ** attempt)
```

emily: Added that under "SDK examples" with a short note about `verify` pointing to the private CA. Also changed the Windows examples to use forward-slash in docs but included literal PowerShell examples for copy/paste.

docs-bot: Automated linkcheck: found 1 broken anchor in PR #2410 -> /install/private#network-checks (anchor moved). Suggested replacement: /install/private/networking-checklist. Label: doc:link-fix.

greg: I pushed a tiny anchor fix in a follow-up commit and added a single-line troubleshooting item: "If requests to HSM return 403 after rotation, confirm token label and PKCS#11 slot mapping (slot numbering can differ between appliances)."

frank: Can we add a short bullet about airgap bundle verification? Customers sometimes use `sha256sum` but forget to check both bundle and manifest. Suggest: `sha256sum redwood-offline.tar.gz redwood-offline-manifest.json`.

emily: Good suggestion — added it and a note about GPG verification for bundles mirrored externally.

infra-bot: CI note: docs-pr lint passed, spellcheck flagged 'masquerade' in US vs UK spelling (marked as accepted).

greg: OK from infra side. Frank — can you do a quick docs review? If green, I'll queue merge.

frank: Reviewing now. Small nit: in the HSM sample config we used `pin = "1234"` for clarity in examples, add a callout to never check real pins into repos.

emily: Updated with a security callout and an example using an env var: `pin = ${HSM_PIN}`. Pushed.

frank: LGTM. Merge when CI is green. Thanks all.

emily: Will follow up with a short changelog entry and add a docs-issue for expanding the migration appendix into a full page later. :memo:
